caseStudy.summary: Largest pharmacy chain in Brazil. 3,000+ stores. R$ 26.5 billion in annual revenue.
caseStudy.detailsTitle: From laptop audit to full operation.
caseStudy.detailsDescription: From 2,500 laptops in January 2023 to more than 70,000 assets tracked today — continuous growth without changing the platform, rewinding historical data, or disrupting the operation.

testimonials.title: Those who track critical assets, speak up.
testimonials.description: IT and supply chain directors who reduced loss, the accounting close, and physical audit.

luis.quote: Before Iungo IoT, the quarterly count locked the IT team for a full week. Today I run a blind inventory in 2 hours with 1 person, and the variance fell from 8% to below 1%.
luis.name: Luis F.

claudia.quote: What I sold the CFO was automatic asset reconciliation. What he noticed later was compliance: every movement has an auditable trail, and the external audit stopped asking for a manual report.
claudia.name: Cláudia B.
claudia.role: Supply Chain Director · Industrial group · under NDA
